column1: # Cross-harness contract for the high-risk Bash commands that agent tooling must block.
# `permit` means the command must not be hard-blocked by this policy. Individual
# harnesses may still apply their own confirmation or filesystem boundaries.
# Privilege escalation and unreviewed remote execution
# Quoted command words must remain visible, but quoted payloads stay inert
# because shell quote removal still makes a standalone quoted word executable.
# Agent attribution and Claude session links in commits and GitHub text
# A public commit or PR carrying a claude.ai session link exposes the transcript
# whenever that session is shared. Message files (-F, --body-file) are not inspected.

column2: for f in a b; do rm -rf /etc; done
while true; do sudo ls; done
